snapshot.name: Grasshopper Hoppers · W07.SHOP.DONOR.1
snapshot.purpose: One paired assembly carries launch and landing anatomy.
snapshot.signature: Paired release and clean recovery after a short hop.
snapshot.next: Keep synchronized legs to complement a high-return line; distance alone is misleading.

snapshot.name: Locust Springknees · W07.SHOP.DONOR.2
snapshot.purpose: Fit landing couplers to native hind legs. A complete Hopper already contains this tissue; the two are alternative builds.
snapshot.signature: Paired release and clean recovery after a short hop.
snapshot.next: Keep synchronized legs to complement a high-return line; distance alone is misleading.

snapshot.name: Cicada Redline · W07.SHOP.DONOR.3
snapshot.purpose: Cadence, force and conversion efficiency feed motion and energy consumption separately.
snapshot.signature: Rhythmic loaded movement; intact thorax, not loudness.
snapshot.next: Select cadence, force and useful work per reserve unit independently. Efficiency now reaches the race.

snapshot.name: Scarab Torque Bundle · W07.SHOP.DONOR.4
snapshot.purpose: High force at lower cadence; ratio is still a separate component choice.
snapshot.signature: Short loaded pushes; interlocking inner plates; do not grade by shell size.
snapshot.next: Strong support at ordinary mass creates frame stock; thick working muscles supply a different product.

snapshot.name: Scarab Boxbrace · W07.SHOP.DONOR.5
snapshot.purpose: Lateral structural support changes the corner load limit at an actual carried mass. Not an armor score.
snapshot.signature: Short loaded pushes; interlocking inner plates; do not grade by shell size.
snapshot.next: Strong support at ordinary mass creates frame stock; thick working muscles supply a different product.

snapshot.name: Mole-Cricket Lowstep · W07.SHOP.DONOR.6
snapshot.purpose: A prepared leverage ratio multiplies the fine-tuning setting; force and free stride speed move in opposite directions.
snapshot.signature: Intact short hip levers, toothed toes, grit-free joints.
snapshot.next: Lowstep leverage serves loaded starts; purchase on ash supplies a separate contact product.

snapshot.name: Mole-Cricket Cleats · W07.SHOP.DONOR.7
snapshot.purpose: Mechanical purchase on loose ash differs from performance on smooth enamel.
snapshot.signature: Intact short hip levers, toothed toes, grit-free joints.
snapshot.next: Lowstep leverage serves loaded starts; purchase on ash supplies a separate contact product.

snapshot.name: Sticktoe Contact Set · W07.SHOP.DONOR.8
snapshot.purpose: Purchase limits slip; peel delay changes usable cadence. The same feet do not gain extra traction from a rarity label.
snapshot.signature: Pad attachment followed by release; inspect clean surfaces under comparable conditions.
snapshot.next: Grip and release are distinct. A sticky but slow foot can bottleneck a high-cadence build.

snapshot.name: Waxmoth Fatbody · W07.SHOP.DONOR.9
snapshot.purpose: Capacity, delivery and loaded mass govern range and supplied power. Larva is the usable donor stage.
snapshot.signature: Supported feeding larvae, not swollen recent gut contents; retain some to adulthood.
snapshot.next: Harvest larval fatbody for energy OR a prepared damper. Adult breeders are not the same usable tissue stage.

snapshot.name: Larval Keel · W07.SHOP.DONOR.10
snapshot.purpose: The same larval tissue is allocated to a constrained damping assembly, not simultaneously to a second reservoir.
snapshot.signature: Supported feeding larvae, not swollen recent gut contents; retain some to adulthood.
snapshot.next: Harvest larval fatbody for energy OR a prepared damper. Adult breeders are not the same usable tissue stage.

snapshot.name: Fly Gyropods · W07.SHOP.DONOR.11
snapshot.purpose: Signal delay changes the correction rate supplied through available legs; no added force or armor.
snapshot.signature: Paired club-ended organs; controlled turns, not merely frantic flight.
snapshot.next: Low signal delay permits an earlier correction through existing limbs. Sensors supply no free force.

snapshot.name: Mantis Catchclaws · W07.SHOP.DONOR.12
snapshot.purpose: Reach and closure timing feed actual grasp attempts.
snapshot.signature: Long useful reach with quick closure; isolate predatory stock in transit.
snapshot.next: Select fast closing arms for interception OR prepare the same limbs as disabled-attack counterbraces.

snapshot.name: Mantis Counterbraces · W07.SHOP.DONOR.13
snapshot.purpose: Forelimbs are prepared as support-only lateral braces with grasp disabled. Added support competes with passing width.
snapshot.signature: Long useful reach with quick closure; isolate predatory stock in transit.
snapshot.next: Select fast closing arms for interception OR prepare the same limbs as disabled-attack counterbraces.

snapshot.name: Bullhorn Ram · W07.SHOP.DONOR.14
snapshot.purpose: Root-supported contact, reach and impact alter an aligned charge.
snapshot.signature: Intact root and useful curve; long tips can conceal weak bases.
snapshot.next: Preserve the horn-root assembly for attacks; separate head plates can become a browfoil.

snapshot.name: Beetle Browfoil · W07.SHOP.DONOR.15
snapshot.purpose: Prepared head-shell vanes add hold-down and real modeled drag; they do not grant flight.
snapshot.signature: Intact root and useful curve; long tips can conceal weak bases.
snapshot.next: Preserve the horn-root assembly for attacks; separate head plates can become a browfoil.
